privileged_info_for_vlm: The source data contains 1000 rows and 5 specific departments: Outerwear, Knitwear, Denim, Accessories, and Footwear. The final output must be an Excel file (.xlsx) named 'markdown_analysis.xlsx' containing a 'Markdown Summary' sheet. The markdown logic follows a strict priority: 50% (WOS>=12 & STR<=40%), then 30% (WOS>=8 & STR<=55%), then 15% (WOS>=4 & STR<=70%).
